SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

4. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose

14. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
